note: Every number R2 integrates, each with its place in the declared documents. R2 read no source paper, engine code, engine output or other reference's code: every value below is copied from the documents at the named tags, or derived from them as stated.

documents.design: docs/MITOCHONDRIA_DESIGN.md at tag mito-mt1b-face-design-2026-11-22 (section 7, the MT-1b draft, the face note)
documents.world_declaration: docs/MITOCHONDRIA_DESIGN.md at tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2026-11-22, the declaration of record: 'MT-1b's world declaration' (G1-G7, first tagged as mito-mt1b-world-declaration-2026-11-22) with the face note's section 6 erratum and G5's erratum (the I_NP rule)
documents.erratum_2: docs/MITOCHONDRIA_DESIGN.md at tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2-2026-11-22, 'Erratum 2': the declaration of record for this run

readings.column: Table 1 (2006) 'with Pi control' column; complex III under Eq. 24 restored as phi_Pi x Eq. 7 (appendix 1.2). Confirmed (world declaration, R2's readings)
readings.binding_set: Mg2+ on ATP and ADP, H+ on Pi and on the matrix buffer B_x, nothing on AMP (appendix 0; G1). Confirmed
readings.eq20: the passive K+ and Mg2+ fluxes across the inner membrane are absent (G1). Confirmed
readings.dpsi: free state, C_IM dPsi/dt = sum_k q_k J_k. Confirmed
readings.face: J_f = gamma p [(c_e - c_P) + z_f v L(c_e, c_P)], v = F(phi_e - phi_P)/RT, into the IMS per unit mitochondrial volume. Confirmed
readings.face_potential: phi_IMS - phi_bath from zero net outer-membrane current over the permeant forms and ions (G5; face note 6 erratum)
readings.bath_speciation: option (a): free pH held; free Mg2+ from Mg_tot through K_MgATP and K_MgADP (G3)
readings.bath_valuation: the held bath's supply valued at each row's free potential (option (a)). Confirmed
readings.o2_supply: G6 (ii), the lead's ruling: O2 held in the bath, supplied through the face at p_Pi and across the inner membrane at P_O2; a declared departure R2 shares
readings.leak: constant-field H+ (Eq. 19) on the IMS's own free H+, h_P, the P side of the inner membrane: world declaration erratum 2 (tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2-2026-11-22), item 1
readings.A_IM: R2's reading, accepted by the lead (22 November 2026): A_IM = C/(1 uF cm-2) exactly, with C = C_IM F per litre of mitochondria (world declaration 0 prints 6.513e-8 m2 for 1 pL, rounded)
readings.controls_b_c: R2's reading, accepted by the lead (22 November 2026): controls (b) and (c) run (a)'s main schedule (0-300 s) from the declared start; the branches are world (a)'s
readings.anchor: G7 with G5's erratum: the matrix charge inventory is the dynamics' conserved matrix charge, I_N = C_IM dPsi + W_x sum_N z_row c_row over frame B's rows (the matrix buffer's base charge, a constant, left out); its value is the one whose state-4 steady state at [Pi]e = 0 has pH_N = 7.1418, computed as the limit [Pi]e -> 0 with the declared traces. The seventh inventory, I_NP = W_x sum_N z c + W_i sum_P z c, is set by zero outer-membrane potential at the anchor state and again at the start state
readings.o2_node: R2's reading, accepted by the lead (22 November 2026): W3(d)'s O2 node is finite from t = 0
readings.P_O2: R2's reading, accepted by the lead (22 November 2026): P_O2 = 9.9e-5 m s-1 as printed

X_Hle.source: world declaration G1: J = X_Hle dPsi (h_P e^u - h_N)/(e^u - 1)

uncoupler_factor.source: world declaration G1: the uncoupler patch at 30 x the leak's P_H A_IM

buffer_N_total.source: world declaration G1: one-site B_x, 40.0 mM

buffer_P_total.source: world declaration G1: no IMS buffer

p_O2_face.source: world declaration G6 (ii) and G7 (d): the face at p_Pi

P_O2_inner.source: world declaration G6 (ii): passive neutral permeation across the inner membrane

C_area.source: world declaration 0: A_IM at 1 uF cm-2

exchange_form.source: appendix 3: the declared form J = S (1 - e^x). 'printed' (Eq. 14's two-fraction form) is plant P-a's option only (the lead's ruling of 22 November 2026)

ADP_atp_bath.source: world declaration G7: the inhibitor branch's bath, ADP 0.5 mM (the uncoupler branch takes it too, the lead's ruling)

pH_N.source: world declaration G7: the matrix charge inventory anchored to pH_x = 7.1418 at state 4, [Pi]e = 0

Pi_e_limit.source: R2: [Pi]e = 0 taken as the limit of these, each a steady state in ln variables

I_NP_rule.source: world declaration G5 erratum (tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2026-11-22): zero outer-membrane potential at the anchor ([Pi]e -> 0) and again at the start ([Pi]e = 10 mM), each IMS at its own bath's free ions

I_N_check.source: world declaration G5 erratum: R2's anchor value, recorded as a check only

protocol.source: world declaration G7 (R2's proposal as accepted)
protocol.world_d_source: O2 depletion starts at 60 s, so 0-60 s is a true state-4 plateau: the lead's ruling of 22 November 2026, for the world declaration's erratum 2 (tag pending)

bands.note: the MT-1b draft's plateau bands (MR1-MT2's), with erratum 2's absolute floors on concentration readouts: band = max(relative band x |value|, floor). The drift rule asks a change below a tenth of the band over the last 10 s

floors.source: world declaration erratum 2 (tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2-2026-11-22), item 3: 0.1% of each pool's declared total (ATP_N and ADP_N of A_tot 10 mM, Pi_N of the bath's 10 mM, K_N of the bath's 150 mM, the IMS adenylates of the bath's 1.3 mM ADP); the O2 flux band has no absolute floor (R2's reading: item 3 floors concentration readouts, and item 4's window covers the O2 flux's vanishing tail)

bands.judged_weight: world declaration erratum 2 (tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2-2026-11-22), item 7: dPsi (plateaus and transients), cytochrome c's reduced fraction, NADH's fraction, pH, the O2 flux outside the window, and concentrations above their floors only

start_guess.note: R2's first guesses for the Newton steady states; the start state itself is the anchored steady state (G7), so these reach no output

concentration_floor.rule: the smallest declared trace (ADP, ATP and AMP in the bath)
concentration_floor.source: world declaration erratum 2 (tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2-2026-11-22), item 2: the floor scales with the trace, so the error control stays relative down to the smallest trace

excluded_window.source: world declaration erratum 2 (tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2-2026-11-22), item 4: every judged readout of world (d) is excluded while the matrix's free O2 (the O2 that complex IV reads) is below 1e-3 x P50; P50 = 0.373 uM (G7), so 0.373 nM, printed rounded as 0.37 nM (R2's reading)

expected_P50_crossing_s.source: world declaration erratum 2 (tag mito-mt1b-declaration-erratum-2-2026-11-22), item 4: a prediction R2's run reports against

plants.source: the MT-1b draft's plants, each to miss by at least 3 bands on a judged row; P-a's printed form: the lead's ruling of 22 November 2026, for the world declaration's erratum 2 (tag pending)

P-a.what: the exchange's shares at 0.35 and 0.70, in Eq. 14's printed two-fraction form

P-c.what: the 2005 k_O2, 1.0e-6 M (appendix 9: the 2005 PDF prints 1.0e-6 for k_O2)
